_meta.adopted_by: author's decision 2026-09-26, scoped to laboratories with a commissioned panel; PROC-MF-02 and PROC-MF-03 (this detector) met B1-B6 on these four labs and failed the fifth-lab bar; PROC-MF-01 (full-covariance matched filter) failed B1-B5 and is a different detector
_meta.detector: f_hat = sum_i w_i t_i r_i / sum_i w_i t_i^2 - centre_lab; t = mu_cell - b/sum(f_blood); r = v - b; b = blood-only NNLS reconstruction on the marker block; w = 1/var of the healthy residual per locus, leave-one-laboratory-out among commissioned labs
_meta.line_rule: quantile min(1 - 1/n, 0.99) of the laboratory's own centred null - a stated quantile, never the raw maximum (PROC-MF-03 lesson)
_meta.sigma: 1.4826 x MAD of the other commissioned laboratories' pooled null (PROC-MF-02 sealed definition)
_meta.gate: runs only when the composition guard verified the specimen as blood-like and the laboratory is in this file
